author: Web Dev Simplified
description:
Permissions are at the core of nearly every project, but most people don’t spend more than a few minutes thinking about them which results in difficult to use and error prone code. In this video I will be covering all the permission systems you need to be aware of and showing you how to choose the perfect system for your application.
